none.describes: No failures at all. Both versions should be perfect here

crash_after_commit.describes: The service dies between saving the order and publishing the event

crash_before_ack.describes: The worker dies after doing the work, before acknowledging

relay_crash.describes: The relay dies after publishing, before recording that it did

duplicate_delivery.describes: The broker delivers every message twice

everything.describes: Worker crashes AND duplicate deliveries, together
